1. (Judgment 5) The role line under the wordmark reads "DESIGNER & ENGINEER", but the record's `identity.role` is "Product Designer & Developer". Set the role line to the recorded role.

2. (Judgment 5) The featured dougmar.ch entry says "A portfolio that redesigns itself every night. The problem: prove each build is actually buildable before the first line of code, and faithful to the brief after the last — committed gestures, not hedges." The record's problem is that a portfolio "argues that you can design and build things, then sits unchanged for years," and the record says the pipeline rebuilds the site "each morning," not every night. Use the recorded problem and approach text, and take the brief's creed out of the work copy.

3. (Judgment 3) Type Treatment declares `alignment: justified` as a solid block. At 1440 only "YOU CAN'T GO" and "AT THE SAME" reach the measure; "FORWARD", "AND", "BACKWARDS" and "TIME." stand ragged at the left. At 360, "AND" and "BACKWARDS" fall short and "YOU CAN'T" opens a wide gap. Re-break or re-set the lines so every line but the last runs edge to edge as one pinned slab at both widths.

[check 6] At 360px, text runs past the edge of the screen and is cut: "You can't go" (x 18 to 384), "and" (x 18 to 384), "at" (x 18 to 384). Set display type in clamp() with a vw term so it fits the column, and let lines wrap.

1. (Judgment 5) The phone work section labels dougmar.ch "FEATURED", but the records mark Spaceman as the featured project (`featured: true`). The page lists Spaceman as an ordinary row. Make Spaceman (Founder, 2018 — Present, Active) the featured entry with its own record copy, and move dougmar.ch into Selected Work with FishSticks and 15th Club.
2. (Judgment 6) The footer reads "NOW PLAYING — The War on Drugs · Wet Leg", which presents the music as happening today. The brief declares it a standing rotation that must never be framed as live. Relabel it as a rotation (for example "In rotation —") and keep it on the right of the baseline rule.

5. The Featured Spaceman block (fold 3 at 360) says "Founding a company means picking one direction and committing before you can know it was the right one. Spaceman is the long bet — chosen early, built, shipped, and still running years on. The proof that the decision held is that it is still here." None of that is in the work records. The record describes Spaceman as "the LLC I've operated under for the past decade, partnering with companies and studios across industries," spanning product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand. Its outcome is "Ten years in, Spaceman is still the vehicle for independent work and new experiments." Replace the invented copy with the record's problem, approach or outcome text, and don't bend the description toward tonight's hero theme.
